technique_de_realisation: Thaw fish if frozen. Place in shallow dish.
Combine oil, parsley, lemon juice, mustard, salt and pepper. Pour over fish.
Let stand at room temperature 2 hours turning occasionally, or marinate covered in refrigerator 4 to 6 hours.
Place fish in well-greased wire grill basket.
Grill over medium to hot coals until lightly browned, 5 to 8 minutes.
Brush again with marinade and grill until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork, 5 to 8 minutes more.
